title: Practice: a data policy for a Claude deployment (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a compliant deployment has no findings
cases.says: A compliant deployment has no findings

cases.id: e1 residency is pinned by the request or by the region the platform allows
cases.says: Residency is pinned by the request or by the region the platform allows

cases.id: e2 zero data retention is an arrangement of the providers own platforms and not of every model
cases.says: Zero data retention is an arrangement of the provider's own platforms and not of every model

cases.id: e3 protected health information needs a covered platform an agreement and deidentified input
cases.says: Protected health information needs a covered platform, an agreement and de-identified input

cases.id: e4 a multi tenant service needs a workspace for each tenant
cases.says: A multi-tenant service needs a workspace for each tenant

cases.id: e5 an audit log must not store prompts that hold sensitive data
cases.says: An audit log must not store prompts that hold sensitive data

cases.id: e6 audit retention stays between the minimum and the maximum
cases.says: Audit retention stays between the minimum and the maximum

cases.id: e7 purge only what is past the retention limit and not on hold
cases.says: Purge only what is past the retention limit and not on hold

cases.id: e8 a request is served only by a deployment that keeps its data in the region
cases.says: A request is served only by a deployment that keeps its data in the region
